derivation: contract C2 `hreflang_invalid_tag`: 'en-' is neither x-default nor a fullmatch of the frozen ASCII grammar ^[A-Za-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z]{4})?(-([A-Za-z]{2}|[0-9]{3}))?(-([A-Za-z0-9]{5,8}|[0-9][A-Za-z0-9]{3}))*$ (case-insensitive); amendment A2 emits one finding for the one offending link.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en-" href="https://alpha.example/a">
</head><body></body></html>

name: invalid-tag-trailing-dash
